'''''Star Wars: Crimson Reign''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] miniseries and crossover event created by [[Marvel Comics]]. It is written by [[Charles Soule]] and drawn by [[Steven Cummings]]. The story focuses on [[Crimson Dawn]] and [[Qi'ra]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]''. The five-part series began publication on [[December 8]], [[2021]]. The series concluded 6 months later in [[June]] of [[2022]]<ref name="Issue 5" /> and continued through ''[[Star Wars: Hidden Empire]]''.<ref name="Hidden Empire 1">[[Hidden Empire 1|''Hidden Empire'' 1]]</ref>
